title: Finance and Administration Assistant
company: Morgan Parkes Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Job Title: Finance and Administration Assistant

Salary: £27,300 - £33,150

Duration: Permanent

Hours: Full time hybrid - 3 days in office, 2 days from home

Location: Meriden

Role Purpose:

Working as part of a supportive team, the successful candidate will be friendly, organised and self motivated, as well as able to work in a varied and flexible role.

This role is hybrid and you will be required to work in the office in Meriden 3 days per week. It is essential you have your own transport as this location is inaccessible by public transport.

Key Duties of a Finance and Administration Assistant:
- Accounts administration including supplier and customer invoicing support
- Reconciliation of credit card transactions and supplier statements
- Invoice processing
- Work alongside other teams within the business to ensure a smooth process at all times
- Chase outstanding paperwork
- Liaise with project support colleagues to resolve queries
- Update the computer system
- General administration as required

Key Skills/Experience Required for the role of Finance and Administration Assistant:
- Previous Accounts Administration experience
- Good understanding of basic accounting principles
- Excellent attention to detail
- Good communication skills
- The desire to continue learning
- Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams)

For more information or to apply please send your CV or contact Morgan Parkes Recruitment.

Morgan Parkes Recruitment Ltd operate in the UK and can only process applications from candidates who are currently eligible to live and work in the UK. We operate a strict equal opportunities policy.

Personal data you supply will be used for contacting you via telephone or email about our service. Your data will be kept securely and retained in line with GDPR regulations. You have the right to withdraw your consent to the use of your personal data for the specified purpose at any time.

title: Receptionist
company: Macildowie Recruitment and Retention - Agency - Temporary
description:
Job Advert

Macildowie are working with this client based in Rugby within the professional services sector to recruit a Temporary Receptionist.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an immediately available individual to join a welcoming and professional environment, acting as the first point of contact for visitors while supporting the wider team with administrative tasks.

Salary: £12.77 per hourEmployment Type: TemporaryWorking Arrangement: Office-based

Working Hours:Monday to Thursday: 7:30am - 4:00pmFriday: 7:30am - 3:00pm

The Role

You will be responsible for managing the front-of-house function, ensuring all visitors and callers receive a professional and friendly experience, while also providing light administrative support to the team.

Key Responsibilities
- Meeting and greeting visitors, ensuring a professional first impression
- Managing incoming calls and directing enquiries appropriately
- Handling incoming and outgoing post
- Supporting with general administrative tasks and data entry
- Maintaining a tidy and organised reception area
- Assisting the wider office team as required

About You
- Previous experience in a receptionist or customer-facing role
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- Professional and approachable manner
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail
- Confident using Microsoft Office and general office systems
- Reliable and punctual, with a proactive attitude

This is an ideal opportunity for someone looking for immediate work in a structured and friendly environment.
